config_text:
# Predeclared before subject-02 acquisition or inspection; no outcome-based tuning.
subjects: [sub01, sub02]
preprocessing:
  time_window: [0.1, 0.5]
  baseline: null
  channels: null
  temporal_bins: null
  min_repetitions: 40
  standardize: false
channel_policy: all 17 supplied posterior/occipital channels, identical names/order required
brain_metric: correlation
vision_metric: cosine
k_values: [5, 10, 20]
split_seed: 20261011
permutation_seed: 1337
repetition_splits: 30
permutations: 1000
top_n: 20
methods:
  jaccard: 1 - set Jaccard of nearest-neighbor sets at K=5/10/20
  row_spearman: (1 - Spearman correlation of the two RDM rows excluding self) / 2
  reciprocal_rank_weighted_jaccard: >-
    All 199 nonself neighbors; assign weight 1/rank normalized by H_199;
    disagreement = 1 - sum(min(brain_weight, model_weight))/sum(max(brain_weight, model_weight)).
    Neighbor-distance ties break by stable image ID. No fitted bandwidth or cutoff.
aggregation: equal-weight mean of DINOv2 and CLIP per-image disagreements
tie_policy: average score ranks for Spearman; stable image-ID tie-break for Top-20
null: permute image labels, then reapply the identical ranking/tie rule; 1000 permutations
inference: exploratory, conditional on shared official whitening; not session-independent
selection_policy: no final metric selection from subject-02; report all methods and models
vision_revisions:
  dinov2: f9e44c814b77203eaa57a6bdbbd535f21ede1415
  clip: 3d74acf9a28c67741b2f4f2ea7635f0aaf6f0268
